scientific_integrity: Analytical exact proof with standalone exact-rational checks. No claim of independent review or comprehensive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two irreducible finite-state reversible spatial phases with the same graph, site-preserving uniform symmetric Poisson switching, and mean stationary edge current; higher-phase, heterogeneous-switching, nonreversible, time-dependent and infinite-space cases are not covered. The generic n-2 bound is shown sharp for n=3 only; historical priority and independent validation remain uncertain.
title: A finite-state reversal bound for two-equilibrium flashing ratchets
